preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of officers N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= C <= 10**9 for C in [int(input().split()[1]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the initial coordinate of Chef C is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= P_i <= 10**9 for P_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, all initial coordinates of the officers P_i are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, input().split()))) == N for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all initial coordinates of the officers are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(C not in map(int, input().split()) for C in [int(input().split()[1]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, Chef's initial coordinate C is not the same as any officer's initial coordinate.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each test case's result is a tuple of two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[0] <= N for result, N in zip(results, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The first integer in each result is the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated by Chef, which is between 0 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result[1] in [-1, 1] for result in results)
postconditions.description: The second integer in each result is either 1 (Chef runs away) or -1 (Chef is caught).
